description: This file defines an API health check class for a web application, implementing the IHealthCheck interface. It checks the health of an API endpoint by making an HTTP GET request and analyzing the response content.

classes.name: ApiHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements a health check for the API by making a HTTP request to a specific endpoint and inspecting its content.

methods.name: ApiHealthCheck
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the health check with configuration settings.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check by sending an HTTP request to the API endpoint and evaluating the response content.
